unblock_options.name: Transfer 512-image calibration subset from 5090
steps: On 5090: Generate manifest with image IDs + SHA256s
On Jetson: tar xzf train2017_calib512.tar.gz -C data/coco/
unblock_options.pros: Minimal transfer, deterministic sampling, fast unblock

unblock_options.name: Transfer full train2017 to Jetson
steps: Download/locate full COCO train2017 (19 GB, 118k images)
Resume C1A with local sampling (seed 20260824, n=512)

unblock_options.name: Use pre-existing calibration subset
steps: Check if 512-image train2017 calibration subset already exists
unblock_options.cons: May not exist or may not match seed 20260824

recommendation.rationale: Minimal transfer, deterministic sampling on 5090 (where train2017 already exists for distillation training), fast unblock (5-10min), sufficient for calibration (512 images).
